name: Debian d-i EROFS and xxhash modules
description: Repo-managed Debian Installer module profile for EROFS media support and xxhash-backed kernel modules.
notes: Use this profile when Debian Installer needs erofs, xxhash, and xxhash_generic support staged through installer kernel udebs.
The paired UDEB rebuild spec updates Debian linux installer module lists and can be overridden with a different source overlay directory during the Build ISO flow.
